name: Longest Common Substring (DP)
description: Finds the longest substring (contiguous) common to two strings using a 2D DP table.
aim: Find longest run of matching characters between two strings using dp[i][j] = length of common substring ending at s1[i-1] and s2[j-1].

complexity.spaceDescription: 2D table; can optimize to O(min(m,n)) with rolling array

whenToUse: Contiguous match required (vs LCS which is subsequence)
alternatives: Suffix array — O(n log n) time O(n) space
